description: Click at viewport coordinates (CSS pixels) via real mouse events — pointerdown/mousedown, pointerup/mouseup, then click on whatever element is hit there. For canvas/map surfaces with no DOM element to index. click_count 2 adds dblclick.

click_count.description: Click count: 1 single (default), 2 adds dblclick, 3+ sets detail

x.description: Viewport X coordinate in CSS pixels

y.description: Viewport Y coordinate in CSS pixels

name: session_click_xy
